Pinned-source conventions: work over the big fppf site $(\Sch/S)_{fppf}$. A category fibred in groupoids is represented by an algebraic space $F$ over $S$ if it is equivalent over the site to $\mathcal S_F$, the category fibred in sets associated to the functor of points of $F$. A fibred category is fibred in setoids when its fibre categories are groupoids and all their objects have trivial automorphism groups. For a presheaf $F$ of sets, $\mathcal S_F$ is its associated category fibred in sets: its objects over $T$ are elements of $F(T)$. A 1-morphism $f:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ of categories fibred in groupoids is representable by algebraic spaces when for EVERY scheme $U$ over $S$ and every $y\in\mathcal Y_U$, the 2-fibre product $(\Sch/U)_{fppf}\times_{\mathcal Y}\mathcal X$ is represented by an algebraic space over $U$.

Let $f:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ be a $1$-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site. Then $f$ is representable by algebraic spaces if and only if both of the following hold: (1) for every scheme $U$ over $S$, the functor $f_U:\mathcal X_U\to\mathcal Y_U$ is faithful; (2) for every such $U$, every $y\in\mathcal Y_U$, and the chosen pullbacks of $y$ in $\mathcal Y$, the presheaf on schemes $h:V\to U$ assigning the isomorphism classes of pairs $(x,\phi)$ with $x\in\mathcal X_V$ and $\phi:h^*y\xrightarrow{\sim}f(x)$ is represented by an algebraic space over $U$.

stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme contained in $\Sch_{fppf}$.
Let $\mathcal{X}, \mathcal{Y}, \mathcal{Z}$
be categories fibred in groupoids over $(\Sch/S)_{fppf}$.
Let $f : \mathcal{X} \to \mathcal{Y}$ be a $1$-morphism
representable by algebraic spaces.
Let $g : \mathcal{Z} \to \mathcal{Y}$ be any $1$-morphism.
Consider the fibre product diagram
$$
\xymatrix{
\mathcal{Z} \times_{g, \mathcal{Y}, f} \mathcal{X} \ar[r]_-{g'} \ar[d]_{f'} &
\mathcal{X} \ar[d]^f \\
\mathcal{Z} \ar[r]^g & \mathcal{Y}
}
$$
Then the base change $f'$ is a $1$-morphism representable by
algebraic spaces.
